title: Stadsmuseum Zoetermeer, exhibition design
excerpt: Exhibition design for the Stadsmuseum Zoetermeer, built around light and interaction.
description:
An exhibition design for the Stadsmuseum Zoetermeer, where light and interaction carry the route through the rooms rather than sitting on top of it.
> Designing an exhibition is deciding what a visitor meets first, and what they are still carrying when they reach the last room. Light does that quietly: it sets the order in which things are seen.
credits: Exhibition design, light and interaction: Jaco Schilp. Stadsmuseum Zoetermeer, 2022.
